title: AAPS 3.4.1.0 and 3.4.2.1 not sending Treatments to Nightscout
body: Yesterday I updated AAPS from DEV 3.4.0.0 to the latest DEV 3.4.2.1 (and I previously updated to from 3.4.0.0. to 3.4.1.0 (both dev and master)). The problem is that latest AAPS i installed doesn't send treatments to my Nightscout (on Northflank). It send devce statuses. The queue number in NSV3 tab is going up and if I do a full sync, it syncs OK and the queue number drops to 0. And after that it rises again. This happened yesterday March 31th between 22:00 - 23:00 hours then ver 3.4.2.1 was installed. In the NSClient tab the "ADD Treatments" simply does nopt appear. See also attached screenshots. After going back to 3.4.0.0. everything is back to normal. This is based on current /dev which had a lot of changes added in last few days... My change is very small, but from functionality it enables refreshes, which include history reading, which is the heart of all functionality of what is added to AAPS Core/Db. 

If you want to add changes to your current checkout just copy the method I added... But yes, new visualization is part of new version... but I think its still work in progress (it is a dev branch)... I am not sure if MDT driver was already changed fully...

So there is dev which is dev for 4.x version, so branch  https://github.com/andyrozman/AndroidAPS/tree/issue_4664 is tied to that.... There is also (at the moment) dev3, which is dev based on latest 3.x version, I have created branch also under that: https://github.com/andyrozman/AndroidAPS/tree/issue_4664_dev3  if you want to stay on old ui (for now)
